caption: The drawing features a wooden table with a dark brown finish, depicted with a central pedestal and four curved legs extending outward, each leg ending in a claw-like foot. The tabletop is rectangular with beveled edges. The central pedestal is ornately carved, containing a vertically ribbed oval section with leaf-like carvings. Two inset detail drawings are present in the upper part of the composition: the left inset shows an enlarged view of the carved section of the pedestal, highlighting the intricate leaf pattern, while the right inset depicts a curved segment, possibly an armrest or part of a leg, also decorated with a repeated leaf motif. The drawing is executed on a plain beige background, with fine black lines framing the main composition and the two inset details.
title: Card Table
